findings.body: Raise: Not done. `read_question` takes a story's delivery from `What changes for you` and never reads `Done when`. Those sections can differ: the story fixture promises a saved-time display in its second Done-when item, but the named read test accepts a question that mentions only saving and returning to a basket. The owner can therefore be asked to choose without seeing what the item delivers.

findings.body: Raise: Not done. This line passes a story or spec title directly into the question, without removing paths or Markdown. The task path also appends the plan's raw story title at `src/forge/review.py:256`. A title containing a Markdown link or source path is printed unchanged by forge read and forge next, or by a stopped task's close, land and next output. The named proofs use plain titles, so they do not catch this Done-when gap.
